notes: Bay Area Reporter, 2 January 1992 to 30 December 1993, 105 weekly issues, read from the Internet Archive's DjVu text (no hOCR). Hand-curated: address clusters and event-word passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, managers, staff, performers or patrons.

coverage.remaining: 1994 to 2005 remain: 604 issues in the collection, January 1994 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 105 issues; 13,916 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 640 windows after the advertisement filter (410 of them rescued for an event word) in 582 address clusters, of which 302 hold an event word; a tighter filter (no classified or personal-ad vocabulary, at most two clusters per address) left 64, all read; plus 815 event-word passages, of which the 26 with a fire, closing, lost-lease or moving word and no out-of-town or review marker were read. 20 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text; 3 take their number from a listing elsewhere in the paper. 16 resolved and published on 15 pages, none seeded; the renaming of the bar at Hamburger Mary's (269 12th Street, a number EAS no longer holds) is placed by hand on the page for 1582 Folsom. Product's opening at 1015 Folsom (October 1992) sits beside the conflict already stated on that page. 3 held (3962 19th Street, 4035 18th Street, 719 Clementina Street). 1 unresolved (208 Dolores Street, the church that burned in August 1993). Not entered: the Jackhammer bar, printed only as a corner.

findings.description: Fire on the night of 1 August 1993 burned the Dolores Street Baptist Church and the Victorian house at 208 Dolores Street that served as its community center, used by more than 40 groups.
